mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, name, employee_no, phone, dept_id, position, status, version, is_deleted, gmt_create, gmt_modified
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO org_employee ( tenant_id, name, employee_no, phone, dept_id, position, status, version, is_deleted, gmt_create, gmt_modified ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{name}, #{employeeNo}, #{phone}, #{deptId}, #{position}, #{status}, #{version}, #{deleted}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE org_employee SET status = 0, is_deleted = 1, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status = 1
